compiled_state.title: [runner.py _read_tier_model]: config path resolves via 3 dirname levels -> dso-config.conf not found in CI
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**What happened**: `_read_tier_model()` in `runner.py` constructs the config path using 3 `os.path.dirname` calls from `__file__` (the runner module). Starting from `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`, 3 dirname levels resolves to `plugins/dso/`, so the function looks for `plugins/dso/.claude/dso-config.conf` which does not exist.

**What was expected**: The function should find the repo-root `.claude/dso-config.conf` (e.g. model.light, model.standard, model.deep keys), requiring 5 dirname levels from runner.py: runner.py → dso_ci_review/ → scripts/ → dso/ → plugins/ → repo root.

**Impact**: `model.light/standard/deep` config overrides in dso-config.conf are never read in CI. The function silently falls back to `_TIER_MODEL_DEFAULTS`. Standard tier still gets `claude-sonnet-4-6` by coincidence (it is the default), so the observable behavior is correct — but a config override would be silently ignored.

**Observed**: Introduced as part of Fix C (PR #56) when `_read_tier_model()` was added. The path computation was written with 3 dirname levels but should use 5.

**Fix direction**: Change `os.path.dirname` chain from 3 calls to 5, or use `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` via subprocess to locate repo root reliably.

FIX NEEDED: Change os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(...))) to 5 levels in _read_tier_model() (line ~88) and the second occurrence (~174).
